summary: Verified hero slider auto-advance bug fix on homepage (http://localhost:3000/). All 4 targeted test cases passed: (1) slide auto-advanced from hero-dot-0 'Racing Jackets' to hero-dot-1 'Opium Archive' after ~6s with zero user interaction, (2) advanced again to hero-dot-2 'Y2K Supplier' at ~13s, (3) manual next-arrow click advanced to hero-dot-3, (4) autoplay continued to hero-dot-4 'Vintage · Baggy Jeans' ~6s after the manual click. Mouse was parked at (0,0) during passive waits so the full-viewport hero could not intercept it, confirming the removed hover-pause regression is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: hero-slider.tsx: autoplay useEffect correctly keyed on [index, paginate, reduceMotion] so the 5s timer resets on manual nav; onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave pause handlers are gone. Behavior matches the intended fix.
Non-blocking: Vercel Speed Insights / Web Analytics scripts 404 in the local dev preview (expected outside Vercel hosting) — noisy console but not a functional issue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero slider autoplay bug fix confirmed at localhost:3000. AUTOPLAY_MS=5000, keyed on index so it resets on manual nav. Test approach: park mouse at (0,0), poll aria-current on [data-testid^='hero-dot-'] every ~6s. Do NOT hover the hero during passive-wait windows or the drag/framer-motion interactions would interfere. Preview external URL was NOT used (502 for /api/*, not required here).
rca of the issue: Original regression: hero <section> is h-[100svh] (full viewport) and had onMouseEnter={()=>setPaused(true)}, so on desktop the cursor was always over the hero and autoplay stayed permanently paused. Fix removed the paused state and the mouse handlers; autoplay now runs unconditionally (except when prefers-reduced-motion is set) and resets on manual navigation via the useEffect [index] dependency.
